textAuthority: Only closed identity, member-sharing, claim-authority, profile-coordinate, ownership, and research-pin fields are normative. Fields named *Explanation or *Explanations are non-normative. Exact field/profile support, rejection, phase, evidence, and delegation semantics live in the independently pinned Packet C case-contract catalog.
identityStatusExplanation: Stable review coordinates; public target and profile names remain gated by the naming ADR.
productionIdentityExplanation: These profile IDs are review coordinates, not production-advertisable identities. A production profile identity and digest must bind the exact versions or digests of every owned and external builder, driver, launcher, guest runtime, helper, protocol, conformance suite, kernel and host-capability envelope, and default-suppression contract. A profile cannot be advertised until that complete registry closure exists and its member-bound conformance evidence passes.
memberSharingExplanation: A target member exists for each distinct tuple of built bytes, workload platform, boot or device requirements, and immutable hard requirements. One byte-identical member may advertise multiple runtime profiles only when builder-produced evidence independently proves every advertised profile compatible with that exact member.

claimAuthorityExplanations.artifactSource: Selects or requires target/profile identities and semantic constraints. It cannot author support, successful construction, or passing-conformance facts.
claimAuthorityExplanations.builder: Constructs target members and emits content identities, compatible runtime-profile claims, applicable conformance-suite identities, results, and evidence.
claimAuthorityExplanations.manifestLoader: Treats every builder claim as untrusted input and verifies identity, structure, evidence linkage, and required-profile satisfaction before creation.
claimAuthorityExplanations.create: Selects one profile proven and advertised by one member; it cannot manufacture a missing profile.
claimAuthorityExplanations.operator: Maps the selected profile to a pinned driver implementation, helpers, compatible hosts, and placement without weakening it.
